facts.name: standard_security

facts.description: Trade date in the relevant market calendar
facts.name: trade_date

interpretations.statement: For a trade classified within the standard US/Canadian securities transition, use one settlement business day from 28 May 2024 in the US and from 27 May 2024 in Canada; use two before each cutover. Exclude FX and other non-covered transactions. This is a historical regime count, not a settlement-date calculator.
